description: Polyphonic envelope with a delay before it starts, a rise, a hold at the top and a fall. Two insert VCAs multiply a signal by the envelope, and each stage has its own pulse output

params.text: The gap between the trigger and the start of the rise, from 0 to 10 seconds
The rise time, from 0 to 10 seconds
How long the envelope holds at its top before it falls, from 0 to 10 seconds
The fall time, from 0 to 10 seconds
Bends the shape of the stages between straight and exponential
Scales the envelope from -2 to +2, so negative settings turn it upside down
Makes the envelope start itself again as soon as it finishes, so it runs as an LFO
Holds the envelope at the top of its hold stage for as long as it is on
Makes every new trigger start the envelope from 0V rather than from the level it has reached
Makes a new trigger count only while the envelope is idle, so a trigger during the envelope is ignored

inputs.text: A voltage added to the gap before the rise
A voltage added to the rise time; a negative voltage is subtracted from it
A voltage added to the hold time
A voltage added to the fall time
A voltage added to the scaling of the envelope
A trigger switches the looping on and off
A trigger switches the holding on and off
A signal to be multiplied by the envelope
A voltage added to the envelope output

outputs.text: The envelope itself, with the voltage at the chain input added to it
Sends a pulse whenever the envelope is started, whether by the trigger input or the button, so several of these can be chained
The signal at that insert's input multiplied by the envelope
Fires when the gap before the rise ends and the rise begins
Fires when the rise ends, at the top of the envelope
Fires when the hold ends and the fall begins
Fires when the envelope reaches the end of its cycle
